reviewNotes:
Hibira Chat is the mobile inbox for support agents of Hibira Live Chat (https://chat.hibira.io), a live chat service that businesses add to their own websites. Agents sign in with a link sent to their work email or with their company's single sign-on; there is no account sign-up in the app, because workspace owners invite their agents from the web portal.

To review: sign in with the demo account below. The inbox lists that workspace's chats. Open a chat to read it, see its rating and reply. To see a new chat arrive, open https://chat.hibira.io/ in Safari and use the chat widget at the bottom right; the app shows a push notification.

The app sells nothing and has no in-app purchases; plans are managed by the workspace owner on the web, and billing pages are hidden in the app.
